mechanics.name: Pharmacy
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever you unlock a Chest, it contains a Rare Med-Kit. You unlock and rummage Chests 75/100/125% faster, you can rummage each Chest once, and the range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is reduced by 12 metres.
activation: Unlock a Chest for the guaranteed Rare Med-Kit.
Unlock or rummage a Chest for the tiered interaction-speed bonus.
Ends/deactivates when: The interaction-speed bonus applies only during Chest unlocking or rummaging.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Expanded the 75/100/125% speed bonus to rummaging and added one rummage per Chest; the Rare Med-Kit guarantee and the 12-metre sound reduction remain.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Chests provide a Rare Med-Kit, can be opened and rummaged much faster, and can each be rummaged once while your unlocking noises carry less far.
duration: Applies during each qualifying Chest interaction.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: Each Chest can be rummaged once.
specialInteractions: The authoritative 10.2.0 notes specify 'a Rare Med-Kit'; the record does not assume a more specific Med-Kit identity.

editorial.summary: Unlock chests much faster and quieter, and every completed unlock guarantees an Emergency Med-Kit.
useCases: Guarantee access to a healing Item without bringing one into the Trial.
Open chests quickly enough that the looting detour is less expensive.
Use multiple unopened chests to create additional Emergency Med-Kits for the team.
counters: A brought Med-Kit avoids the entire search-and-unlock detour.
Chest time is still time not spent repairing generators.
pros: Guaranteed useful item rather than random loot.
125% faster Tier III chest unlocks are quick.
cons: Uses time to acquire a resource that can simply be brought from the lobby.
Lower value when the team already has healing Items.
analysis: Pharmacy ranks in C/B boundary because the perk guarantees something useful rather than gambling on chest RNG. An Emergency Med-Kit has clear practical value, and the large chest-opening speed bonus significantly reduces the normal looting tax.

The perk is most attractive when the Survivor intentionally enters without a Med-Kit or wants to generate additional team healing resources from the map. Plunderer's Instinct and Appraisal can turn that into a broader chest-economy build.

The obvious comparison is the pregame loadout. If you already own a strong Med-Kit, bringing it directly is faster and costs no perk slot. Pharmacy must justify both the slot and the travel to an unopened chest.
That makes it useful resource generation rather than competitive general value. It does its job reliably, but the job itself is optional.
The 10.2 version also supports rummaging, which strengthens its role inside chest and item-economy builds.
editorial.verdict: A reliable way to turn a chest into a Med-Kit quickly. Pharmacy is good at solving an Item problem that many players can solve before the Trial even begins.
